about.message: Verifies that enough articles are available before starting the download.
about.description: Help text for the about option in Completion. 'Articles' are technical data blocks/segments of a file in Usenet. Use terms like 'Segments', 'Parts', or 'Blocks'. Avoid 'Newspaper/Text articles'.

description.message:
The extension checks if the data in the NZB file is sufficiently complete at your usenet provider(s), before starting the download.

If incomplete it would wait for a certain period and check the completion of the NZB file again.
This check is done by requesting the header STAT/HEAD,
and is in normal cases done within seconds (like 1 - 5 sec. for a 1 GB file).
This method is significantly faster than when NZBGet would report a failure,
after actual downloading a (part of) the files that end up incomplete.
The script is typically useful for issues related to:
- very recent posts
- failed downloads, which after a while are just ok (propagation issues),
- incomplete posts,
- taken down posts (DMCA, etc.),
- old posts,
- long par repair times,
- downloading (parts of) NZB files beyond repair,
- unnecessary use of expensive block / slow fill accounts.

NOTE: To stop the script or delete the .lock file, restart NZBGet via SYSTEM.

requirements.message: Python 3.8.0 or higher is required to be installed on your system.
requirements.description: Help text for the requirements option in Completion.

agelimit_desc.message:
NZB max age.

Max age of the NZB file in hours till the scheduler script stops checking
the NZB file, moves it to the history, and marks it BAD or FAILED. Basically
this defines the maximum propagation delay.
This option is also used for the FillServer option.
Default = 4.
agelimit_desc.description: Help text for the AgeLimit option in Completion.

agesortlimit_desc.message:
NZB max sort age.

Max age of the NZB file in hours till the scheduler script stops prioritizing
age over queue order. Basically this defines the upperbound of the take down window.
Default = 48.
agesortlimit_desc.description: Help text for the AgeSortLimit option in Completion.

checkdupes_desc.message:
Check duplicate NZBs stored in the history.

NZBs with the DUPE status in the history will be checked, note
NZBGet option DupeCheck needs to be enabled for this to work.
The option SameScore will only check the dupes that have the same or higher
DUPE score as the item in the queue. This means that only when the file in the queue is
older than AgeLimit and marked BAD or FAILED, a lower score DUPE could be
moved back to the queue.
Default = SameScore.
checkdupes_desc.description: Help text for the CheckDupes option in Completion. DO NOT translate 'NZBGet'.

forcefailure_desc.message:
The NZBGet mark BAD option might not be supported by programs like Sonarr.

Therefore this option forces a failure, so Sonarr will know that it has to
push an other nzb, because the current one failed.
NOTE: This option will result in a warning messages for each .rar file and at
least one error from NZBGet when forcing the FAILURE status.
Default = Yes.
forcefailure_desc.description: Help text for the ForceFailure option in Completion. DO NOT translate the fixed values 'yes' and 'no'. DO NOT translate 'NZBGet'. DO NOT translate the exact uppercase label (NOTE) as they are used to render UI badges.

setparamsonsuccess_desc.message:
Sets post-processing parameters for the group when the completion check succeeds.

Specify parameters as 'ParamName=ParamValue, ParamName2=ParamValue2'.
Example: 'CompletionCheck=True, DownloadStatus=Success'.
Default = blank.
setparamsonsuccess_desc.description: Help text for the SetParamsOnSuccess option in Completion.

setparamsonfailure_desc.message:
Sets post-processing parameters for the group when the completion check fails.

Specify parameters as 'ParamName=ParamValue, ParamName2=ParamValue2'.
Example: 'CompletionCheck=False, DownloadStatus=Failure'.
Default = blank.
setparamsonfailure_desc.description: Help text for the SetParamsOnFailure option in Completion.

checklimit_desc.message:
Percentage of archive articles to check.

A higher percentage will be more accurate, but will increase the duration of
the check.
Default = 10.
checklimit_desc.description: Help text for the CheckLimit option in Completion. 'Articles' are technical data blocks/segments of a file in Usenet. Use terms like 'Segments', 'Parts', or 'Blocks'. Avoid 'Newspaper/Text articles'.

minarticles_desc.message:
Minimal number of articles to check.

Increases number of articles to be checked on very small NZB files.
Default = 50.
minarticles_desc.description: Help text for the MinArticles option in Completion. 'Articles' are technical data blocks/segments of a file in Usenet. Use terms like 'Segments', 'Parts', or 'Blocks'. Avoid 'Newspaper/Text articles'.

maxarticles_desc.message:
Maximum number of articles to check.

Reduces the time it takes to check large NZB files.
Won't override the FullCheckNoPars option.
Default = 1000.
maxarticles_desc.description: Help text for the MaxArticles option in Completion. 'Articles' are technical data blocks/segments of a file in Usenet. Use terms like 'Segments', 'Parts', or 'Blocks'. Avoid 'Newspaper/Text articles'.

fullchecknopars_desc.message:
Check all archives when no pars.

Force a full check on all the archives articles in the release when no or
only 1 par file is included. This to guarantee all articles are there and you
don't waste bandwidth because just 1 article is missing.
Default = Yes.
fullchecknopars_desc.description: Help text for the FullCheckNoPars option in Completion. DO NOT translate the fixed values 'yes' and 'no'. 'Articles' are technical data blocks/segments of a file in Usenet. Use terms like 'Segments', 'Parts', or 'Blocks'. Avoid 'Newspaper/Text articles'.

categories_desc.message:
Categories to check for completion.

Comma separated list like 'TV-HD, TV, Movies, etc'. Leave blank for all
categories. Note that the category of an NZB file is shown in the download
and history queue.
Default = blank.
categories_desc.description: Help text for the Categories option in Completion.

servers_desc.message:
Servers to use for completion check.

Comma separated list like '1, 3, 4'. Leave blank for all news-servers.
News-server numbers are equal to the server numbering in the NZBGet settings
on the NEWS-SERVERS tab.
Suggestion is to specify at least your main news-servers.
Default = blank.
servers_desc.description: Help text for the Servers option in Completion. DO NOT translate 'NZBGet'. If 'News server' sounds like 'Newspaper' in your language, use 'Usenet server'.

fillservers_desc.message:
FillServers to use for completion check, will only be used in last check.

Comma separated list like '1, 3, 4'. Leave blank for no news-servers.
News-server numbers are equal to the server numbering in the NZBGet settings
on the NEWS-SERVERS tab. Last check is check when NZB is older than AgeLimit.
Suggestion is to specify your fill/block news-servers.
Default = blank.
fillservers_desc.description: Help text for the FillServers option in Completion. DO NOT translate the fixed values 'yes' and 'no'. DO NOT translate 'NZBGet'. If 'News server' sounds like 'Newspaper' in your language, use 'Usenet server'.

maxfailure_desc.message:
Maximum failure percentage for main server.

This option requires that at least X percent of the articles are available on
the lowest Server.Level and Server.Group news-server (your main news-server).
When more than X percentage fails on your main news-server, the NZB is
skipped to avoid burning through fill servers. Use 0 to disable.
Default = 0.
maxfailure_desc.description: Help text for the MaxFailure option in Completion. If 'News server' sounds like 'Newspaper' in your language, use 'Usenet server'. 'Articles' are technical data blocks/segments of a file in Usenet. Use terms like 'Segments', 'Parts', or 'Blocks'. Avoid 'Newspaper/Text articles'.

ignorequeuepriority_desc.message:
Ignore queue priority and always validate items immediately

Default = No.
ignorequeuepriority_desc.description: Help text for the IgnoreQueuePriority option in Completion. DO NOT translate the fixed values 'yes' and 'no'.

verbose_desc.message:
Print more info to the log for debugging.

Default = No.
verbose_desc.description: Help text for the Verbose option in Completion. DO NOT translate the fixed values 'yes' and 'no'.

extreme_desc.message:
Print even more info to the log for debugging.

This will print your news-server passwords in the logs too.
Default = No.
extreme_desc.description: Help text for the Extreme option in Completion. DO NOT translate the fixed values 'yes' and 'no'. If 'News server' sounds like 'Newspaper' in your language, use 'Usenet server'.

checkqueue_desc.message:
Queue check.

To check the by the script paused items in the queue manually, click the
'Check' button. A scheduler call will then be executed.
checkqueue_desc.description: Help text for the CheckQueue option in Completion.
